text: When Senator Williams said we need to rethink our approach to criminal justice, she conveniently forgot to mention that she received $200,000 in campaign donations from private prison lobbyists. Of course she wants reform — reform that keeps the cells full and the money flowing. And while we're focused on her rhetoric about rehabilitation, violent crime is surging in every major city across the country. A recent poll shows that 78% of Americans believe the justice system is broken, and they're right. The bleeding-heart liberals running our cities have blood on their hands.
